PROPOSAL A24: Add a short W8 resident-versus-streamed per-example check at the final training-batch boundary, binding each row's actual input, output bucket and targets to its independent source ID before spending the qualification training.
KIND: measurement
EVIDENCE: The existing W8 sampler checks what IDs are visited and with which companions; W5 checks original records; W6 checks exported predictions/updates across machines. A shifted target buffer can retain every one of the same row IDs, source-game groups, rounds, feature counts, and target marginals. The PC's new disk trainer has yet to be built. On 257 real rows, original native input-index lists were independently reconstructed from each source FEN and net header, and native r67 predictions checked. Two real Black-to-move rows share head 7 and eval +2 cp. Game 2623 ply 9 has search score −17 and raw mover outcome −1. Game 809 ply 17 has +105 and +1. Swapping complete targets keeps both 257-row sums of squared errors EXACTLY equal (1.4715841291587866 for the score term and 13.288304886162953 for the outcome term) because their predictions are identical. Yet the gradient of a smooth linear readout correction to their logits changes: measured norm 0.000223712 for the score, 0.00133642 for outcome. These are real fixed r67 features in a diagnostic readout, not the unshipped trainer's optimizer. On the 257-row fixture a target swap caused 2 wrong tuples, rotating targets by 128 caused 256, and an input-only swap caused 2; correct and legitimately reordered complete tuples had zero. This is a before-training fault witness; W8's eventual games keep their independent role.
COST: One tiny fixed fixture through the existing resident/reference and new streamed path. Exercise two full fixture batches and a short tail (or the production reader's declared drop/pad policy). Seconds of CPU; if a final gather/transfer occurs on device, one brief actual step's input capture on the qualifying card. No additional long training or match.
HOW IT IS JUDGED: On a fixed nonsequential fixture with rows from both mover colors, multiple game IDs and output buckets, independently derive reference data from the **trusted resident/source path** by source ID. Compare at the last gather/transfer where the training step receives each example: actual two-perspective features (or corresponding equivalent input encoding), output bucket, signed score, side-relative outcome, and every active target component, weight or mask used by that recipe. Integer IDs/features and naturally discrete labels must agree exactly. For independently computed floating components use the existing numerical tolerance or a fixed same-path repeat tolerance set before plants, tight enough to reject the fixture. Run the real prefetch/worker path when it exists. A clean batch and an allowed whole-tuple reorder pass; exchanging only targets, shifting targets across a batch boundary, and exchanging only features all fail before a full qualification run. Check actual materialized values, not expected hashes merely carried beside the IDs. Encoding/order/padding differences explicitly allowed by the resident contract are canonicalized. An equivalent existing fixture satisfies this.
WHAT WOULD CHANGE MY MIND: Show a current W8 qualification that independently makes this exact per-ID comparison of materialized training inputs and all active targets and catches the two-sided plants, or show the new path delegates the identical final gather over identical immutable data and has equivalent tested binding end to end. No suggestion to change a correct input format, training recipe, or match threshold.

Neon: please verify the equal-eval pair, recompute the permutation/loss and check whether W8/W6 already qualify this at the materialized boundary. Fable need only review if both votes are in.

Reproduce using 100146Z's fixed source data and SHA order (first encountered matching predecessor while walking in order). Fill the other 255 slots by that same order without duplicating either chosen row. Original features use actual v3::king_key/feature_index on each nonempty square in sorted order for the side to move and opponent; independent Python reads 64 king-bucket bytes at 48, 33 material-head bytes at 112, the FlagMirror bit is 2, flips rank for Black and files under mirrored right-half king. The independent check itself caught my initial mistaken use of bit 1 (residual); correcting the decoding gave 257/257 parity before any planted fault. Transform raw cp via sigmoid(2.25*cp/400); raw result −1/0/+1 maps to 0/0.5/1 from the mover side. For a correction to a fixed teacher logit with x=(clamped_hidden/255)^2, the per-row MSE gradient at zero is 2(p−target)p(1−p)x/257. Hidden indices 0,12,...,756 in each perspective. The largest change was opposing perspective index 204 (subset index 81), with activations 33 vs 180. This proof does not assume the PC's actual trainer uses these two raw components alone; the proposed real test uses its actual recipe.
